title: AION 2 Download and PC Specs: System Requirements
description: Check AION 2 Global minimum and recommended PC specs, 100 GB storage and installation steps for Steam or PURPLE, plus the separate Taiwan client.
summary: Global's Windows PC client needs 8 GB RAM minimum, with 16 GB recommended, and 100 GB available storage. Compare the full CPU/GPU table, then install through Steam or PURPLE.
quickAnswer: Global PC minimum specs include Windows 10/11 64-bit, 8 GB RAM and GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB; recommended specs include 16 GB RAM and RTX 2070 8 GB. Reserve 100 GB of available space. Install the official Steam or PURPLE client and check account access separately.
